channel.title: Core Happiness
channel.itunes:summary:
The Core Happiness™ podcast is geared towards inspiring listeners to become more mindful, gain clarity, and learn science based tips that will empower them to live their best lives while achieving personal and professional goals. Hosted by Master Certified Mindset & Positive Psychology Coach, Kacee Banks, each episode is crafted to send the message to listeners that they are not alone by sharing resources, tools, stories and experiences to encourage personal awareness and growth.
Core Happiness™ is a place for learning, experiencing, inspiration, motivation, and awareness reminders. Free of judgment and negativity. The belief behind Core Happiness™ is that we can live a life full of happiness, love, peace and abundance if we nourish ourselves with those things. Once you begin to become self-aware and use the aid of others to nourish your soul with positivity, love, hope and inspiration you will find your inner self growing more empowered, confident, motivated, and gaining inner and strength, all of which is then reflects externally to the world, your world. This podcast is to serve as inspiration and motivation to create a happy life by creating happiness within. Additional resources and support can be found at www.corehappiness.com.
_______
Disclaimer: If you or someone you know is experiencing suicidal thoughts or a crisis, please reach out immediately to the Suicide Prevention Lifeline at 800-273-8255 or text HOME to the Crisis Text Line at 741741. These services are free and confidential.

item.itunes:title: From Toxic Patterns to True Self-Worth with Kamini Wood
item.description:
Are you tired of people-pleasing, over-functioning, or living for everyone’s expectations but your own? In today’s Core Happiness Podcast episode, I’m joined by human potential coach and bestselling author Kamini Wood for a deeply grounding conversation about healing codependency, breaking toxic patterns, rebuilding self-trust, and learning how to become your own self-leader.

We explore how high achievers slip into burnout and perfectionism, why boundaries trigger guilt, how mindfulness supports emotional regulation, and how to shift from “doing” to “being” so you can live in alignment with your core values.

Whether you're recovering from toxic relationships, navigating shame, or learning to trust your voice again, this episode will help you reconnect with yourself and create a life that feels like you.

✨ Listen in to learn:

• Subtle signs of codependency that often go unnoticed

• How to step into emotional independence without guilt

• What self-leadership really looks like in daily life

• Why shame and “I should be further along” keep us stuck

• Practical mindfulness tools for anxiety and self-regulation

• How to rebuild self-trust one small step at a time

item.description:
Feeling the pressure to reinvent yourself this new year? What if the clarity you’re craving isn’t found in becoming a new you… but in returning to the core version of who you’ve always been?

In this powerful Season 4 kickoff of the Core Happiness Podcast, Kacee Banks unpacks why so many of us feel stuck, disconnected, or behind and how beginning again doesn’t mean starting over. It means realigning with your values, your truth, your inner compass.

Inside this episode:

item.description:
In this episode, we dive into the surprising wave of emotions that can rise up after you set a boundary. If you’ve ever said “no” and then immediately spiraled into guilt, shame, or second-guessing, you’re not alone. We explore why these reactions surface, what they reveal about your deeper healing, and how to move through them with compassion instead of self-criticism.

This episode will help you understand your emotional landscape, honor your inner voice, and stand by your boundaries with confidence, even when it feels uncomfortable.

item.title: Healing the Wounds You Can't See with Julie Hall
item.itunes:title: Healing the Wounds You Can't See with Julie Hall
item.description:
In this episode of the Core Happiness Podcast, we welcome Julie Hall, a licensed marriage and family therapist, to discuss the deep emotional roots behind repetitive patterns in our daily lives and relationships. Julie shares her journey from the tech industry to becoming a therapist and the personal experiences that catalyzed her career shift. Using a blend of compassion, mindfulness, and trauma-informed therapy, she helps individuals navigate from survival mode to feeling genuinely safe and connected. Listen as we delve into the concept of the 'adaptive child' versus the 'wise adult,' how early family dynamics influence our present behaviors, and the importance of self-compassion. Julie also explores practical steps for nurturing emotional safety in relationships and highlights therapeutic approaches like EMDR and Emotion-Focused Therapy (EFT). Don't miss this insightful conversation packed with valuable insights for achieving emotional well-being and healthier connections.

item.title: The Body-Mind Shortcut to Happiness: Janice Kaplan on Gratitude, Stress & Joy
item.itunes:title: The Body-Mind Shortcut to Happiness: Janice Kaplan on Gratitude, Stress & Joy
item.description:
Can your body lead the way to happiness—even before your mind catches up?

In this inspiring conversation, bestselling author, journalist, and former Parade editor-in-chief Janice Kaplan joins us to explore the real science behind happiness, gratitude, and the body-mind connection.

We revisit the powerful lessons from her global bestseller The Gratitude Diaries, where a year of intentional appreciation reshaped her marriage, mindset, and meaning. Then, Janice takes us inside her newest book What Your Body Knows About Happiness—where posture, soft chairs, gentle movement, and even the warmth of your coffee mug prove that your body is already wired for joy.

You’ll learn:

- How gratitude changes the brain and relationships

- Why emotions begin in the body, not just the mind

- Myths about venting, exercise, and “blowing off steam”

- The surprising science of happiness, posture & space

- 4 easy ways to reset your mood through body cues

- How to feel better—without trying so hard

Whether you're navigating stress, craving fulfillment, or simply ready to feel good again, this conversation offers soul-deep insights backed by science.

What if the biggest thing holding you back... was your own mind?

In this deeply moving and eye-opening episode, psychologist, speaker, and author Dr. Ashley Smith shares her personal journey of navigating a rare degenerative eye condition that left her legally blind—and how she used that adversity to unlock a life of boldness, joy, and true psychological strength.

We explore the science behind anxiety, limiting beliefs, and why your brain is wired to keep you stuck—and what to do about it. Ashley breaks down how thoughts shape reality, the real reason happiness doesn’t come from outside success, and how to build self-compassion and resilience in a world that constantly pushes fear and perfection.

Whether you're feeling stuck in self-doubt or seeking a deeper understanding of happiness and human strength, this episode will leave you inspired—and equipped—to live more boldly from the inside out.

Feeling stuck in the darkness of anxiety? You’re not alone. item.title: Welcome! An Introduction to Core Happiness™
item.itunes:title: Welcome! An Introduction to Core Happiness™
item.description:
An introduction to the Core Happiness™ Podcast.

Core Happiness™ was founded for you….for all of us. We live in world full of roles and responsibilities that require us to wear many different hats. Think about all of the different roles you play in one single day. It is easy to lose sight of one’s true self. With the daily demands that have been placed on everyone, especially women, we often find ourselves feeling, tired, alone, confused, and often worn-out as we try to wear so many hats ranging from family (mother, wife, divorcee, girlfriend, daughter, sister, etc.) to work (stay at home mom, corporate climber, entrepreneur, part-time, contractor, etc.), to provider and nurturer, to last (but not least) a woman (who you are as an individual, your hobbies, your dreams, your fears, your health, etc.). This podcast is geared towards sharing stories and tools for growth and awareness to show that we are not alone and to encourage mindfulness and awareness so we can grow as individuals.

Life can be challenging, each and every one of us is often faced with obstacles, trials, and barriers that can make it feel like the universe is against us…but guess what, it isn’t! What if we all used our stories and experiences to help others through similar difficulties and challenges?! Imagine the support and encouragement you’d feel as opposed to feeling alone and in despair. Well, that’s why I created Core Happiness™. Each and every one of us experiences so many different things, feelings, and emotions during our journey throughout life and I believe we are here to learn from and connect with each other. My experiences may be what you need to make your journey easier or maybe YOUR experiences could be the key to helping ease the pain, discouragement, or sadness of someone else.

Learn more at www.corehappiness.com

 

The only journey is the one within. – Rainer Mara Rilke

With the daily demands that have been placed on everyone, especially women, we often find ourselves feeling, tired, alone, confused, and often worn-out as we try to wear so many hats ranging from family (mother, wife, divorcee, girlfriend, daughter, sister, etc.) to work (stay at home mom, corporate climber, entrepreneur, part-time, contractor, etc.), to provider and nurturer, to last (but not least) a woman (who you are as an individual, your hobbies, your dreams, your fears, your health, etc.). This podcast is geared towards sharing stories and tools for growth and awareness to show that we are not alone and to encourage mindfulness and awareness so we can grow as individuals.

Life can be challenging, each and every one of us is often faced with obstacles, trials, and barriers that can make it feel like the universe is against us…but guess what, it isn’t! What if we all used our stories and experiences to help others through similar difficulties and challenges?! Imagine the support and encouragement you’d feel as opposed to feeling alone and in despair. Well, that’s why I created Core Happiness™. Each and every one of us experiences so many different things, feelings, and emotions during our journey throughout life and I believe we are here to learn from and connect with each other. My experiences may be what you need to make your journey easier or maybe YOUR experiences could be the key to helping ease the pain, discouragement, or sadness of someone else.

Learn more at www.corehappiness.com
